comparison.objective: Join two metal strips with a blind rivet and dispose of the spent stem.
comparison.physical_skill: Load and insert a rivet, hold a riveter square and seated, pump sprung handles, then handle the snapped stem.
comparison.success_condition: Rivet set through both strips, stem in tray, tool returned; pulling tilted >6° or unseated permanently fails.
comparison.reason: Tests tool alignment under repeated squeezing and irreversible fastener setting, not reversible collar adjustment, socket reacquisition, and performance testing.
